questions.prompt: How does the root’s inorder position divide the subtree?

choices.label: Put every smaller value left and every larger value right.
choices.feedback: This is not necessarily a BST. The inorder position, rather than value comparisons or equal sizes, determines the two subtree ranges.

choices.label: Split the remaining values into two equal-sized halves.
